nodes.rationale: Use migrations as the single source of truth for schema: create an initial schema migration containing the complete base schema, enable [db.migrations] in config.toml, and remove the manual setup_local_db.sh script. Rejected alternatives: keeping DDL-first setup (fights Supabase tooling), seed.sql schema (execution order is migrations-then-seed by design), generating DDL from migrations (adds build complexity), and deleting DDL files (they remain architecture documentation, one file per concept).

nodes.label: Main Branch Protection (ADR 0002)
nodes.rationale: An accidental git push origin HEAD:main overwrote origin/main with feature commits; the recovery force-pushed upstream/main:main, losing ~60 fork-specific Bloomington commits until a reflog recovery. Decision: GitHub branch protection requiring PRs for main (generate-calendar.yml workflow exempt for automated commits), documented hard fork model where origin/main intentionally diverges from upstream/main, and an agent directive in AGENTS.md never to reset or force-push main to match upstream.

nodes.label: One Branch per Target Main (ADR 0003)
nodes.rationale: A fix created on top of origin/main does not cherry-pick cleanly onto upstream/main because shared files have diverged (e.g. test_timezone_pipeline.py). Decision: a fix destined for upstream gets two branches (fix/<slug> on origin/main and fix/<slug>-upstream on upstream/main), re-applied against each target's file versions rather than cherry-picked; chore/upstream-sync-* branches stay clean; upstream contributions are cross-fork PRs; fork-side delivery is always a PR because main is branch-protected (ADR 0002).

nodes.label: Headless verification gate (ADR 0004)
nodes.rationale: Sync PR #40 merged upstream's PushSource refactor and broke search (processedEvents ran twice because collapseLongRunningEvents keyed its cache on object identity, so the second emit always missed). PR #41 reverted wholesale; upstream then fixed the root cause by keying the cache on stable content. Decision: re-adopt PushSource + IndexedDB via a full merge gated by a headless Node benchmark (bench_collapse_long.js), prune non-Bloomington content during merge resolution, and track residual perf items as fork issues. Rejected: keeping the revert forever, selective cherry-pick, and live-browser-only verification.
